intro.subtitle: Before you begin, discover the journey that awaits you.
intro.videoTitle: Introduction to Your Forest Transformation Journey in English

paragraphs.purpose: This journey is for those who want to turn confusion into clarity, for those who feel they keep repeating patterns and are ready to look inward and change — or break — routines that no longer serve them. If you carry a little responsibility, curiosity, honesty, perseverance, and a genuine desire to find your purpose, the Forest is calling you.
paragraphs.missions: It is also for those who simply want to know themselves better, to discover something they never knew lived within them. Across 9 missions, you will explore different landscapes of the Forest, and with each mission you will earn a token: a small artifact of growth that will become part of the raft that carries you into your next chapter.
paragraphs.presence: This journey does not ask for perfection. It asks for presence and honesty with yourself. Some steps will feel light; others will feel like walking through mud. Both matter. Both transform you. The Forest opens to those who are willing.
paragraphs.calling: If you feel even the faintest call, the Forest is already waiting.

journeyEnd.title: Congratulations, you completed the journey
journeyEnd.intro: You walked the forest from beginning to end. Each token is a footprint of what you dared to look at along the way.
journeyEnd.letter1: If at any point you feel the desire to share what this journey awakened in you, you can reach out to me. It would be an honor to hear your reflections, your discoveries, or even the questions that surfaced along the way. There is no pressure and no expectation — just an open door.
journeyEnd.letter2: If you believe this process could help someone you care about, feel free to share it. Sometimes a single invitation becomes the beginning of someone else’s healing.
journeyEnd.letter3: And if at any moment you wish to go deeper into your process or continue this work together, we can do that with intention and care.
journeyEnd.signature: With deep respect for your courage and your path, Andrea
journeyEnd.contactMessage: Hi! I completed my Forest Journey and I’d like to book an appointment with you.
journeyEnd.confirmBody: All your answers and all the tokens you earned will be deleted, and you will start again from Mission 1. This cannot be undone.
journeyEnd.confirmKeep: Your account and your access stay as they are.

missionPanelDescriptions.1:
Notice where you have come to a stop.
Write gently to that part of you.
Take the first step with honesty.
missionPanelDescriptions.2:
Explore the roots of your beliefs.
Separate your truth from borrowed beliefs.
Choose which roots you want to keep.
missionPanelDescriptions.3:
Move even without perfect clarity.
Name three possible next steps.
Choose one and try it for seven days.
missionPanelDescriptions.4:
Listen to the emotion you have silenced.
Let it flow freely onto the page.
Name it without judging yourself.
missionPanelDescriptions.5:
Clarify the goal you truly desire.
Imagine the life that reaching it opens.
Define how you will move toward it.
missionPanelDescriptions.6:
Look at a storm that transformed you.
Name what it broke and revealed.
Recognize what it also gave you.
missionPanelDescriptions.7:
Step carefully into your own cave.
Write to the part you hide most.
Receive it with compassion, without fixing it.
missionPanelDescriptions.8:
View your path from a wider perspective.
Tell how the journey transformed you.
Recognize its turns and lessons.
missionPanelDescriptions.9:
Gather the pieces earned in the forest.
Choose what to carry and leave behind.
Write where you want to set sail.

reminders.title: A Few Gentle Reminders
reminders.intro: This journey asks for neither haste nor perfection. Keep these words close as you make your way through the forest.

honesty.title: Honesty above all.
honesty.body: This guide is only for you. No one is grading it. The more truthful you are, the more powerful it will be.

compassion.title: Self-compassion over speed.
compassion.body: Take all the time you need with each mission. A week per mission is fine. A month is fine. The forest is patient.

play.title: Play over perfection.
play.body: The mini-actions are invitations, not tests. If one does not fit, adapt it. Make it your own.

raft.title: The raft is built one token at a time.
raft.body: By Mission 9, you will have collected eight artifacts, and together they form everything you need to leave the shore. Trust the process, even when you cannot see the far shore.

privacy.title: A Note on Confidentiality
privacy.body: You may write your reflections on the platform or on paper, if you prefer. Reflections saved on the platform are linked to your account and can only be viewed by you throughout your journey. Your privacy is protected.

reminders.return: The forest awaits. Back to the map.

missionGuide.open: What you’ll find in each mission
missionGuide.title: What you’ll find inside each mission
missionGuide.intro: Each of the 9 Missions in this program follows the same clear and warm structure, designed to take you deep without overwhelming you, and to move you forward without rushing you.
missionGuide.luz: Luz will be with you on every one of your missions.
missionGuide.luzAlt: Luz, your guide in the forest

initial.name: Opening Question or deep-thought phrases
initial.body: Four questions labeled A–D. Read all four and choose the one that resonates most deeply with you right now. There is no right answer — only the most honest one.

description.name: Mission Description
description.body: A narrative video that sets up the metaphor for this stage of the journey. Take it in slowly. Let it land before you continue.

miniAction.name: Mini-Action
miniAction.body: A concrete, doable task. This is not homework. It’s an invitation. Do it when you’re ready, not just when you have time.

reflection.name: Reflection Question
reflection.body: Three or four journaling questions that deepen your experience of the mission. You don’t need to answer them all — only the ones that resonate with you most.

token.name: Reward / Token
token.body: The forest artifact you earn when you complete each mission. Collect them all — they become your raft for Mission 9.

consequence.name: Gentle Consequence
consequence.body: A note to remind you that this journey is walked with awareness and patience. You can move forward, go back, or pause whenever you need to. What matters is completing each mission with presence and receiving its teaching. It is not a warning or a punishment — it is an act of care and honesty.

quote.name: Closing Quote
quote.body: A closing line to carry with you as you walk toward the next part of the forest.

8.p1: You’ve walked through seven missions already — seven moments of honesty, courage, clarity, and growth. Before you step into the next challenge, pause for a moment here in the forest.
8.p2: Has something shifted in you? Do you feel a little stronger, a little clearer, a little more grounded in who you’re becoming? Is there a new sense of confidence or empowerment rising quietly inside you?
8.p4: From this place, ask yourself the following questions… and allow Mission 8 to meet the version of you that has already begun to change.

guided.title: The entrance to the forest
guided.thresholdGeneric: A new stretch of the path
guided.sidebarDescriptionFirst: A space to let go, listen, and choose how you want to begin.
guided.sidebarDescriptionGeneric: A space to move forward calmly, listen to what arises, and take the next step.
guided.sideNote: Don't look for the perfect answer. This space is for listening to what needs your attention today.

sidebarImportance.1: It is important to move through this mission because, without this step, the forest remains imaginary — a fear rather than a place you can navigate. Stagnation remains theoretical, which means it remains forever. The edge is only frightening until you cross it.
sidebarImportance.2: It is important to move through this mission because unexamined roots silently direct our choices — we keep circling the same trees, taking the same paths, arriving at the same clearing and wondering why it always looks familiar. Understanding the roots does not change where you come from. It changes where you go.
sidebarImportance.3: It is important to move through this mission because staying in the fog too long turns confusion into paralysis — the forest begins to feel endless, and the options you once had quietly close. The fog is temporary. The habit of waiting for it to lift on its own can become permanent.
sidebarImportance.4: It is important to move through this mission because suppressed rivers find other outlets — anxiety, tension, sudden floods at unexpected moments and with unexpected people. What we refuse to name gently will eventually name itself out loud. It is better to choose the moment than to be surprised by it.
sidebarImportance.5: It is important to move through this mission because, without a goal, effort becomes movement without direction — busy, sincere and exhausting, but building toward nothing. We can be very productive in the forest and never find our way to the clearing if we never stop to ask where we are really trying to go.
sidebarImportance.6: It is important to move through this mission because unprocessed storms leave invisible wounds — we begin to avoid the weather altogether, choosing smaller lives in the hope of avoiding future disruptions. But avoidance has its own cost: a life lived under constant shelter is a life never fully lived in the open air.
sidebarImportance.7: It is important to move through this mission because what lives in the cave will eventually find its way out — often at the moments we least expect and with the people we least intend. The shadow we refuse to own begins to own us. Meeting it consciously is always gentler than being surprised by it.
sidebarImportance.8: It is important to move through this mission because staying at ground level in the forest means never seeing how far you have actually come. Progress is real, even when it is invisible from where you stand. Without perspective, courage becomes harder to sustain — because you cannot see what you have been building toward with so much effort.
sidebarImportance.9: It is important to move through this mission because, without completing the crossing, the forest becomes a home rather than a passage — and some people stay lost not because they cannot find the way out, but because they never believed there was one. You have done the work. The shore is behind you. The river waits. The only thing left is to move away.

nextSteps.1: In Mission 2 you will go deeper into your roots, your limiting beliefs, your patterns, and your habits.
nextSteps.2: In Mission 3 you will begin to see clearly what you truly need and what you are ready to let go of.
nextSteps.3: In Mission 4 you will explore your emotions more honestly, to understand what they are showing you and where they want to guide you.
nextSteps.4: In Mission 5 you will learn to hold yourself steady in moments of doubt, and to recognize your own inner strength.
nextSteps.5: In Mission 6 you will discover new perspectives and open space for possibilities you could not see before.
nextSteps.6: In Mission 7 you will connect with your intuition and with the part of you that knows more than you imagine.
nextSteps.7: In Mission 8 you will integrate what you have learned and begin to build from your new clarity.
nextSteps.8: In Mission 9 you will recognize your transformation and take the final step toward a more conscious, more authentic version of yourself.
